featureSchema.snippet:
import { z } from 'zod'

export const baggingWorkOrderSchema = z.object({
    id: z.string(),
    bwoNumber: z.string(),
    plannedQtyKg: z.number(),
    actualQtyKg: z.number(),
    wasteQtyKg: z.number(),
    packagingOwnership: z.number(),
    status: z.number(),
    ownerId: z.string(),
    ownerName: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    sourceItemId: z.string(),
    sourceItemName: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    targetItemId: z.string(),
    targetItemName: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    sourceLotId: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    createdTime: z.string().optional().nullable(),
    createdBy: z.string().optional().nullable(),
})

export type BaggingWorkOrder = z.infer<typeof baggingWorkOrderSchema>

export const BaggingStatusOptions = [
    { label: 'bagging.status.draft', value: '0' },
    { label: 'bagging.status.inProgress', value: '1' },
    { label: 'bagging.status.paused', value: '2' },
    { label: 'bagging.status.completed', value: '3' },
    { label: 'bagging.status.cancelled', value: '4' },
    { label: 'bagging.status.qualityCheck', value: '5' },
]

export const PackagingOwnershipOptions = [
    { label: 'bagging.packagingOwnership.warehouse', value: '0' },
    { label: 'bagging.packagingOwnership.owner', value: '1' },
]

track5A: BR-5A-001: BillingTransaction is append-only — corrections via CreditNote only
BR-5A-002: DailyStorageSnapshot runs at system_config.snapshot_time (default 23:59 UTC+7)
BR-5A-003: Storage fee = sum(closing_qty_mt × rate × day_type_multiplier) for each day
BR-5A-004: Free days: days where storage fee = 0. Mode determines how to count
BR-5A-005: HIGHER_OF_TWO billing: max(flat_amount, per_unit_rate × qty)
BR-5A-006: DebitNote can only be edited in Draft status
BR-5A-007: CreditNote can only be created for Locked DebitNotes
track5B: BR-5B-001: Source item must be BULK cargo_form, target must be BAGGED
BR-5B-002: Source and target must belong to same owner
BR-5B-003: On completion: 3-4 InventTrans posted atomically (1 transaction)
BR-5B-004: New bagged lot has source_lot_id = original bulk lot (traceability)
BR-5B-006: DPM nominal trans: is_nominal=true (not materialized in on_hand)
BR-5B-007: Packaging ownership: Warehouse → deduct from TVL stock; Owner → no deduction
